expr: [FirstPosition, [List, [List, a, a, b], [List, b, a, a], [List, a, b, a]], b]
caption: The first occurrence of $b$, nested inside the first sublist
The empty list when the value isn't found anywhere
wolfram.note: Ours returns the empty list when nothing matches (no default given); Wolfram's own FirstPosition returns Missing["NotFound"] in that case. Different not-found sentinels, same search.

caption: A match nested inside an earlier sublist beats a plain match later at the top level: depth-first, outer to inner, left to right
